name: Route to Madness
source:
You have entered the R.T.M. Program. Your role is to observe, record, and question. Every file contains a different mind on the edge. 

Choose carefully which case you will begin with.

[From [url=https://sleepyred.itch.io/route-to-madness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已进入R.T.M。程序。你的角色是观察、记录和提问。每个文件都包含着不同的想法。

仔细选择你要从哪种情况开始。

[来自[url=https://sleepyred.itch.io/route-to-madness]Itch.io[/url]]
